text: At your request information from the PM USA R&D Department files and other literature
sources, as necessary, has been evaluated and a summary document has been
prepared. The document attached to this cover letter should still be viewed as a DRAFT
which may be revised as more information is located. However the attached document
should be sufficiently complete for your immediate needs or for this DRAFT document to
be made available to others in RD&E.
This document is a survey of the technical issues and work activities of one year (1956)
at the R&D Department. An effort was made to select and to summarize a few
documents which would be representative of the larger database. This report is not
presented as or intended to represent an all inclusive survey of activities or documents
from a particular year at PM USA R&D.
